heard: lookouts on the Titanic had no binoculars. Many believe the ship sailed without them by mistake. But during the delivery voyage, the crew actually used them. A last-minute officer reshuffle forced David Blair off the ship. He accidentally kept a locker key in his uniform pocket. Frederick Fleet testified that binoculars would have spotted the iceberg sooner. Without that key, the lookouts on the Titanic had no binoculars.
